title: Introducing GPT-5.4
description: Introducing GPT-5.4, OpenAI’s most most capable and efficient frontier model for professional work, with state-of-the-art coding, computer use, tool search, and 1M-token context.

title: Ensuring AI use in education leads to opportunity
description: OpenAI shares new tools, certifications, and measurement resources to help schools and universities close AI capability gaps and expand opportunity.

title: Introducing the Adoption news channel

title: Introducing ChatGPT for Excel and new financial data integrations
description: OpenAI introduces ChatGPT for Excel and new financial app integrations, powered by GPT-5.4 to accelerate modeling, research, and analysis in regulated environments.
author: Desconocido

title: The five AI value models driving business reinvention
description: Five AI value models show how leaders can sequence AI from workforce fluency to process reinvention and build durable business advantage.
author: Desconocido

description: A new preprint extends single-minus amplitudes to gravitons, with GPT-5.2 Pro helping derive and verify nonzero graviton tree amplitudes in quantum gravity.
author: Desconocido

title: How Axios uses AI to help deliver high-impact local journalism
description: Axios COO Allison Murphy explains how the company uses AI to support local reporters, streamline newsroom workflows, and deliver high-impact local journalism at scale.

title: Understanding AI and learning outcomes
description: OpenAI introduces the Learning Outcomes Measurement Suite to assess AI’s impact on student learning across diverse educational environments over time.

author: Desconocido

title: Our agreement with the Department of War
description: Details on OpenAI’s contract with the Department of War, outlining safety red lines, legal protections, and how AI systems will be deployed in classified environments.
author: Desconocido

title: Scaling AI for everyone
description: Today we’re announcing $110B in new investment at a $730B pre money valuation. This includes $30B from SoftBank, $30B from NVIDIA, and $50B from Amazon.
author: Desconocido

title: Joint Statement from OpenAI and Microsoft
description: Microsoft and OpenAI continue to work closely across research, engineering, and product development, building on years of deep collaboration and shared success.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing the Stateful Runtime Environment for Agents in Amazon Bedrock
description: Stateful Runtime for Agents in Amazon Bedrock brings persistent orchestration, memory, and secure execution to multi-step AI workflows powered by OpenAI.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI and Amazon announce strategic partnership
description: OpenAI and Amazon announce a strategic partnership bringing OpenAI’s Frontier platform to AWS, expanding AI infrastructure, custom models, and enterprise AI agents.
author: Desconocido

title: An update on our mental health-related work
description: OpenAI shares updates on its mental health safety work, including parental controls, trusted contacts, improved distress detection, and recent litigation developments.
author: Desconocido

title: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory and OpenAI partner to accelerate federal permitting
description: OpenAI and Pacific Northwest National Laboratory introduce DraftNEPABench, a new benchmark evaluating how AI coding agents can accelerate federal permitting—showing potential to reduce NEPA drafting time by up to 15% and modernize infrastructure reviews.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI Codex and Figma launch seamless code-to-design experience
description: OpenAI and Figma launch a new Codex integration that connects code and design, enabling teams to move between implementation and the Figma canvas to iterate and ship faster.
author: Desconocido

title: Disrupting malicious uses of AI | February 2026
description: Our latest threat report examines how malicious actors combine AI models with websites and social platforms—and what it means for detection and defense.
author: Desconocido

title: Arvind KC appointed Chief People Officer
description: OpenAI appoints Arvind KC as Chief People Officer to help scale the company, strengthen its culture, and lead how work evolves in the age of AI.
author: Desconocido

title: Why we no longer evaluate SWE-bench Verified
description: SWE-bench Verified is increasingly contaminated and mismeasures frontier coding progress. Our analysis shows flawed tests and training leakage. We recommend SWE-bench Pro.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI announces Frontier Alliance Partners
description: OpenAI announces Frontier Alliance Partners to help enterprises move from AI pilots to production with secure, scalable agent deployments.
author: Desconocido

title: Our First Proof submissions
description: We share our AI model’s proof attempts for the First Proof math challenge, testing research-grade reasoning on expert-level problems.
author: Desconocido

title: Advancing independent research on AI alignment
description: OpenAI commits $7.5M to The Alignment Project to fund independent AI alignment research, strengthening global efforts to address AGI safety and security risks.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing OpenAI for India
description: OpenAI for India expands AI access across the country—building local infrastructure, powering enterprises, and advancing workforce skills.
author: Desconocido

description: OpenAI and Paradigm introduce EVMbench, a benchmark evaluating AI agents’ ability to detect, patch, and exploit high-severity smart contract vulnerabilities.
